briefing.en: A wall splits the room. Guide MX-01 around it, collect the energy cell, then open the exit. Commands run top to bottom.
briefing.id: Sebuah dinding membelah ruangan. Arahkan MX-01 mengitarinya, ambil sel energi, lalu buka pintu keluar. Perintah dijalankan dari atas ke bawah.

en: Walls block movement. Find the gap.
Use robot.action() while standing on the energy cell.
Order matters: cell first, exit second.
id: Gunakan robot.action() saat berdiri di atas sel energi.
Urutan penting: sel dulu, baru pintu keluar.

starter:
# Move MX-01 around the wall to the energy cell.
# Then reach the exit.
robot.move("up")

objects.prerequisite_error: The exit is offline. Finish the earlier objective first.
